title: Price Stability in the European Union: A Systemic Approach Using Random Matrix Theory - Replication Spec
sample: Monthly inflation rate variations (HICP / Consumption Price indices) for 27 Eurozone member countries. System matrix W = T x N with no pre-processing or transformation on normalized inputs tilde(W). Correlation matrix X = 1/N tilde(W)^T tilde(W) for eigenvalue extraction. Sample sizes as printed: N_countries=27, T_observations=307 covering period January 2001 - July 2026 per Section 4. Note inconsistency: Abstract states January 2021 to July 2026. Filters: none stated. Per-country and per-period filters: not stated.
method: 1. Build T x N system W with N=27 countries, T=307 monthly HICP inflation variations January 2001-July 2026 from Eurostat. No pre-processing. Tilde(W) = normalized W.
2. Compute sample correlation WISHART X = 1/N tilde(W)^T tilde(W). Extract eigenvalues lambda_i ordered bar(lambda)_1 > ... > bar(lambda)_n > 0.

3. MP null benchmark: f(lambda)=N/T sqrt((lambda_+-lambda)(lambda-lambda_-))/(2pi sigma^2) for lambda in [lambda_-,lambda_+], 0 otherwise, with lambda_- = sigma^2(1-sqrt(T/N))^2, lambda_+ = sigma^2(1+sqrt(T/N))^2, Wigner semicircle asymptotic. Aspect ratio Q = T/N.

4. SETOL via WeightWatcher https://github.com/CalculatedContent/WeightWatcher: empirical spectral density (ESD) log-log regression, Power-law fit rho(lambda) ~ lambda^{-(a mu + b)} with a=1/2,b=1 for ideal alpha~2, Pareto w_ij(mu) ~ C/x^{mu+1}. Determine lambda_- optimal by lowest Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance D_KS to theoretical Power-law. Report lambda_minus_opt, sigma_MP, alpha_info_corr, D_KS_alpha, mu_Pareto. Scan lambda_- in [100,160] perfect fit, >200 underfitting.
5. Random MP comparison: compare ESD to randomly generated theoretical max rand lambda_+^{rand}. Spikes > lambda_+^{rand} interpreted as Dragon-kings / correlation trap, phase transition.

6. Iterative stability: condition numbers kappa_E(X)=sqrt(bar(lambda)_1/bar(lambda)_n) and kappa_D(X)=sqrt(sum bar(lambda)_i / bar(lambda)_n) computed expanding monthly on new data 2019-2026 with base estimation 2001-2018. Report corr_kappa_D_E and corr_HICP_2019_2026.

7. Denoising: NNSD s_i=|bar(lambda)_i-bar(lambda)_{i-1}|. Theoretical GOE P_GOE(s)=pi/2 s exp(-pi/4 s^2) vs modular Exp P_Exp(s)=exp(-s). Iterative negative log-likelihood distances to both; threshold = regime change point. Report NNSD_cutoff. Clean correlation matrix at cutoff.

8. Clustering on denoised X: leading eigenvector of modularity matrix Newman 2006 and Walktrap short random walks Harel 2001 / Pons 2005 for communities. Report num_communities_lead_eig and community_East_size_stated.
